purpose: Teach: 対人/竹下/地主/産ん/取り出す/昌/キツイ/岬

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「対人面で困ったら相談に来てね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said if you ever have trouble getting along with people, you can always come talk to him.
lines.style: Soft unhurried relay of dad's words, warm reassuring settle at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと竹下景子さんの女優論を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I listened to Dad talk all about the actress Keiko Takeshita!
lines.style: Small proud rush, careful over the long grown-up name, shy smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「地主だった曾祖父の話」を聞かせて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me the story of your great-grandfather — he was a landowner, you know.
lines.style: Storybook hush, leaning in closer, gentle wonder painted over the old detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ママが僕を産んで下さった時の話」聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, Dad told me the story of when Mom had me!
lines.style: Quiet awed delivery, slowing on the word Mom, a small breath of amazement at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い記念品を蔵から取り出すのを手伝って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to help take the old keepsakes out of the storehouse.
lines.style: Bright gentle news-sharing, a little conspiratorial lift in the middle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと曽祖父の昌一郎の墓参り行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, I went with Dad to visit great-grandpa Shoichiro's grave!
lines.style: Solemn-proud child report, careful syllables on the big name, earnest finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「今年の繁忙期はキツイ」って漏らされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad let slip that the busy season has been really tough this year.
lines.style: Softened confiding tone, a sympathetic dip, careful not to worry the little one.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと房総の岬でキャンプしたよ
lines.en: Mei-neesan, me and Dad went camping out on the cape in Boso!
lines.style: Bursting happy finale, words tumbling faster, a little bounce on camping.
